response.diary: Sat Jan 10: Val tested positive and is isolating. I feel fine but worried; masking in crowds, studying in quiet spots, and offering Val a food drop-off.

messages.text: So sorry, Val. Thanks for telling us. Rest up! I can drop off food or supplies outside your door, just tell me what you need.
Thanks Oli, sounds good. I'll keep masking in crowds and keep distance. Let me know if you feel off too.

response.thoughts: Val is positive and isolating. I feel fine and my last test was negative, but I'm worried. I'll keep my studious routine, but study in quieter spots, mask in crowds, and skip the football game. I'll text Val offering a food drop-off and reply to Oli. I'll stay warm and supportive.
